caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a reddish-brown hue, sitting on four short, rounded legs. The lid of the box has an engraved design consisting of a stylized bird and floral patterns, and is bordered by a series of small rivets or nails, one at each corner. The body of the box consists of flat panels with horizontal wood grain, and there is a circular metal or wooden medallion on the side facing the viewer. The edges of the box are trimmed with molding, lending it a framed appearance. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist’s signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Desk Bell from Fire Department
